apps.title: keyd
apps.description: Remaps keys at the evdev level, below XKB and Wayland, so it applies in every session including the login screen. Caps Lock is Esc when tapped and Ctrl when held; Ctrl in this manual means held Caps Lock.

bindings.label: Tap for Esc; hold or combine with another key for Ctrl

groups.description: Uses overload rather than overloadt: Ctrl activates on key-down, so fast chords such as Ctrl+Space never produce a stray Esc. The tap timeout is under Global settings.

apps.title: niri
apps.description: Mod is Super. Navigation uses the vi home row; Shift moves instead of focusing, Ctrl carries the column to another workspace. All bindings are defined in this config, so stock niri bindings such as Mod+Q (close) do not exist.

Emoji and Unicode picker: types into the focused window and copies
Calculator (qalc): units, currencies, bases; copies the result

apps.title: waybar
apps.description: Workspace dots on the left, clock and weather in the center, notification bell and status pill on the right. Clicks mirror keyboard bindings: the language chip matches Mod+Space, the bell matches Mod+Shift+N.

groups.name: Workspace dots
groups.description: Each workspace is a dot in its own colour; the focused one widens into a pill and urgent ones pulse. Empty workspaces stay visible, and 1-3 are persistent in the niri config.

During a screen recording a red REC chip leads the status pill; clicking it stops the recording (same as Mod+Shift+R).
